_about: Public-domain Lorenzo Scupoli (1530-1610, Theatine) in English for the Word Hoard: The Spiritual Combat with the Path of Paradise (London: James Burns, 1846), the Rivingtons new translation (1875) and Thomas Barns's translation (Methuen, about 1909), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 24 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

scupoli-combat-1846: The Spiritual Combat, with the Path of Paradise, translated for members of the English Church (London: James Burns, MDCCCXLVI)
scupoli-combat-1875: The Spiritual Combat, with the Supplement and the Path of Paradise, a new translation (London: Rivingtons, MDCCCLXXV)
scupoli-combat-barns: The Spiritual Combat, tr. Thomas Barns (London: Methuen; catalogued 1909)

_alternates.scupoli-copies: The Burns translation, second edition (1849) and Oxford 1868; Suttaby (1884); Rivingtons 1890; New York 1817
_alternates.scupoli-castaniza: The Spiritual Conflict (1598-1652) and The Spiritual Combat 'by John de Castaniza' (1698, 1710, 1742-1788): anonymous or credited to Castaniza, so they wait on an authorship ruling

_excluded.scupoli-other-languages: Gaelic, Italian, Latin and other editions
